test_title: PYST 17: SSC GD Constable 2024 - Quantitative Aptitude (Held On: 24 Feb, 2024 Shift 1)
subject: maths
question: The marked price of a cycle is Rs. 2700. If 10 percent discount is given, then what will be the selling price of the cycle?
solution:
**Given:**

Marked price of the cycle = Rs. 2700

Discount = 10%

**Formula Used:**

Selling Price = Marked Price - (Discount% of Marked Price)

**Calculation:**

Discount% of Marked Price = 10% of Rs. 2700

⇒ Discount = (10 / 100) × 2700

⇒ Discount = 0.10 × 2700

⇒ Discount = 270

Selling Price = 2700 - 270

⇒ Selling Price = 2430

**The selling price of the cycle is Rs. 2430.**
